### 🪟 Windows are actually windows now
- An unbroken pane stops you walking into the room — you can't stroll through a window as if the glass weren't there any more.
- Bullets, arrows, grenades and your line of sight still pass straight through, breaking the glass on the way. A shot through a window and out the far side takes both panes and still hits the man behind them.
- A grenade going off blows out every window around it, not just the one it flew through.
- Once a pane shatters, the hole is a way in.

### 🏷️ Kill Confirmed is scored on the tags
- The point now goes to whoever picks the tag up, not to whoever landed the kill — the body on the floor is what the match is decided on.
- Taking your own tag back still voids the kill against you, and now pays you the same point anyone else would have got.
- The scoreboard, the HUD strip and the win check all count tags taken.

### 🔫 Arms Race rewards the rung you're on
- A kill only moves you up the ladder when you land it with the weapon your rung gave you.
- Knifing someone still knocks them back a rung — but it no longer advances the knifer, so the bow and the snipers have to be played rather than skipped.

### 🛒 Shop and buy menu
- The weapon catalogue lays out in columns, so the whole list is visible without scrolling past it.

### 📜 Changelog page
- Each release folds, with an expand-all / collapse-all button; the newest one is open when you arrive.
